name: consent_record
description: Protected, two-step. A parent or guardian lets SIA act for their child in some services. Only a recorded parent or guardian can consent.

subject.description: The child: resident number, or just the child's first name (matched only among the caller's own recorded children).

scopes.description: Comma separated scopes, for example school_application

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
